description: This file defines the 'ModelInfo' class, which models metadata information related to entity models, such as title, description, copyright, author, version, and default resource name. It includes methods to create instances from XML element attributes and child elements, as well as getters for its properties.

classes.name: ModelInfo
classes.description: Immutable class representing metadata about an entity model, including title, description, copyright, author, version, and default resource name. Provides static factory methods to create instances from XML attributes or elements.

methods.name: createFromAttributes
methods.description: Creates a ModelInfo instance from XML element attributes, using a default ModelInfo for missing values.

methods.name: createFromElements
methods.description: Creates a ModelInfo instance from XML child elements, using a default ModelInfo for missing values.

methods.name: getCopyrightString
methods.description: Generates a copyright string with a year range from 2001 to the current year.
